recommendations.headline: Call satisfaction is the single biggest profit lever: satisfied calls convert at 73% vs just 10% for neutral and 3% for dissatisfied calls, but 67% of all 1,887 calls (1,069 neutral + 191 dissatisfied) are not satisfied.
behaviour: Price-shopping dominates: 353 customers (19%) are tagged price_shopper and 198 (10%) are comparing_quotes, while 572 calls (30%) are pure price enquiries.
Most calls stall rather than close: 1,039 calls (55%) end in callback vs only 360 (19%) orders and 162 (9%) interested.
Stock and price are the two biggest blockers: stock_availability (322 calls, 17%) and price_high (308, 16%) top the objection list, and stock is also the #1 stated need (364 calls, 19%).
Price is rarely even discussed: in 1,311 of 1,887 calls (70%) price_reaction is 'not_discussed', yet price_high objection still appears in 16% of calls.
Repeat/bulk/urgent buyers are sizable but under-leveraged: 191 bulk_buyer, 195 urgent_buyer, 170 repeat_buyer calls exist, but only 8 are tagged loyal_to_us and 13 referral.
satisfaction: Only 542 of 1,887 calls (29%) are rated satisfied; 1,069 (57%) are neutral and 191 (10%) dissatisfied.
Satisfaction is the strongest predictor of sales: win rate is 73% when satisfied vs 10% neutral and 3% dissatisfied - fixing the 'neutral' middle is the biggest growth lever.

On price specifically, acceptance is low: only 145 calls (8%) show price 'accepted' and 78 (4%) 'too_high', while win rate on price_high objection calls is a moderate 21% - implying price itself is less of a blocker than how it's handled.

Reps are leaving satisfaction on the table operationally: no_follow_up_fixed (335 calls) and slow_or_unclear_answer (334 calls) are the top two missed-action tags, directly dragging satisfaction down.

conversion.title: Lock a firm follow-up time on every call
conversion.evidence: 335 calls (18%) flagged no_follow_up_fixed; 1,039 calls (55%) end in callback with no committed next step.
conversion.action: Reps must state and log a specific day/time for the next contact before ending every call; managers to audit CRM for calls without a scheduled follow-up.

conversion.title: Speed up and clarify rate/stock answers
conversion.evidence: 334 calls (18%) flagged slow_or_unclear_answer; price_enquiry is the top intent (572 calls, 30%) and stock_availability is the top need (364 calls, 19%).
conversion.action: Give reps a live stock+rate sheet/dashboard so they can answer size/grade/price questions on the call instead of 'checking and reverting'.

conversion.title: Send the quote immediately, same call
conversion.evidence: 206 calls had no_quote_sent; many 'did not convert' summaries end with 'rep to send via WhatsApp' with no follow-through.
conversion.action: Make WhatsApp quote-on-call mandatory for every price enquiry; supervisor to spot-check same-day quote delivery.

conversion.title: Always offer an alternative when stock is short
conversion.evidence: 145 calls show didnt_offer_alternative; stock_availability objection has only a 16% win rate, the lowest alongside credit_terms (14%).
conversion.action: Train reps to proactively suggest alternate size/brand/grade (e.g., E250 for E350) whenever the exact SKU is unavailable.

conversion.title: Explicitly ask for the order
conversion.evidence: 128 calls show didnt_ask_for_order; order outcome is only 19% vs 55% callback.
conversion.action: Add a mandatory closing question ('Shall I book this for you / send the PO link?') as the last step of every price/product call.

conversion.title: Qualify unknown-segment callers early
conversion.evidence: 'Unknown' segment is 485 calls (26% of volume) but converts at only 14% vs 33% for dealers and 35% for fabricators.
conversion.action: Capture segment (dealer/fabricator/contractor etc.) in the first minute of the call so reps can tailor pitch and pricing approach.

conversion.title: Engage on price proactively rather than avoiding it
conversion.evidence: 70% of calls (1,311) show price 'not_discussed'; only 8% show acceptance.
conversion.action: Train reps to introduce rate and value justification early in the call rather than waiting for the customer to ask repeatedly.

offers.title: Cutting-to-size / processing service package
offers.why: cutting_processing need appears in 200 calls (11%); multiple 'went well' calls closed after cutting was agreed.

offers.title: Delivery tracking & proactive status updates (WhatsApp/SMS)
offers.why: fast_delivery is the #2 need (342 calls, 18%) and regular_updates is #3 (235 calls, 12%); delivery_time objection appears in 132 calls.

offers.title: Document-assured orders (TC/MTC/tag bundled by default)
offers.for_whom: All TMT/plate buyers, especially site-delivery and quality-sensitive customers
offers.why: quality_doubt objection (134 calls) and test_certificate need (136 calls) are major and recurring, with many questions on MTC/tag clarity.

offers.title: Evaluate structured credit terms for established dealers
offers.why: needs_credit behaviour (87 calls) and credit_terms objection (73 calls) exist, though win rate on credit_terms objection is lowest at 14%, suggesting unclear policy today.

offers.title: Flexible small-quantity/part-load option
offers.why: min_quantity objection (45 calls) and small_quantity need (29 calls) show demand for lower minimums.

offers.title: Multi-brand sourcing assurance
offers.for_whom: Customers comparing brands (JSW, SAIL, NMDC, Jindal mentioned)
offers.why: Competitor brand mentions are frequent (JSW 20, NMDC/SAIL/Jindal 12 each) and customers often ask 'which brands do you have'.

loyalty.title: Repeat-buyer recognition tier
loyalty.how: Flag repeat_buyer accounts in CRM and give them a named contact/priority callback slot.
loyalty.why: 170 calls (9%) show repeat_buyer behaviour but only 8 are tagged loyal_to_us - loyalty isn't being reinforced.

loyalty.title: Proactive daily/weekly rate & stock broadcast
loyalty.how: Send a WhatsApp broadcast list of current stock and indicative sizes to known dealers/fabricators.
loyalty.why: regular_updates is a top-3 need (235 calls, 12%) and many customers ask for rate updates unprompted.

loyalty.title: Fast-quote SLA commitment
loyalty.how: Promise and track a maximum response time (e.g., quote within X hours) for registered customers.
loyalty.why: no_quote_sent (206 calls) and slow_or_unclear_answer (334 calls) are top complaints hurting trust.

loyalty.title: Referral incentive (non-price)
loyalty.how: Offer priority service or dedicated support for customers who refer new business.
loyalty.why: referral behaviour is currently only 13 calls - an untapped channel given 972 dealer relationships.

loyalty.title: Dedicated account manager for top dealers/fabricators
loyalty.how: Assign named reps to high-volume/repeat accounts rather than rotating call handling.
loyalty.why: Dealer (33%) and fabricator (35%) segments already convert best; protecting these relationships compounds the win-rate advantage.

non_price_benefits.title: Guaranteed test certificates / MTC with every dispatch
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt objection (134 calls) and test_certificate need (136 calls); many customer questions about tags, heat numbers, and MTC clarity.

non_price_benefits.title: In-house cutting & processing capability
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need cited in 200 calls (11%), among the top customer needs.

non_price_benefits.title: Multi-brand stock availability (SAIL, NMDC, JSW, Jindal, Vizag)
non_price_benefits.why: Frequent competitor-brand mentions and repeated questions like 'which TMT brands do you have'.

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable, tracked delivery with committed timelines
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery (342 calls, 18%) and delivery_time objection (132 calls) are both high-frequency; many questions ask 'will the truck/material arrive by X'.

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent, assured supply even in shortage periods
non_price_benefits.why: consistent_supply need (141 calls) and stock_availability both as top need (364) and top objection (322).

non_price_benefits.title: Technical/grade advisory support
non_price_benefits.why: needs_technical_help behaviour (245 calls, 13%) and technical_advice need (147 calls) show customers value guidance on grade/size selection.

top_questions.question: Can you send me the rate/quote (on WhatsApp)?
top_questions.answer_tip: Share the rate on call or via WhatsApp immediately with a clear validity window rather than promising to 'check and revert'.

top_questions.question: Is [this size/grade/brand] available now?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm from a live stock view; if unavailable, offer an alternate size/grade/brand on the same call.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce/match a competitor's rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Acknowledge the comparison and pivot to value points - certification, stock reliability, delivery speed - before escalating any rate discussion to a manager.

top_questions.question: Can you send the test certificate/MTC/tag details?
top_questions.answer_tip: Make TC/MTC/tag dispatch a standard step with every order confirmation, not something customers must chase.

top_questions.question: When/will the truck or delivery arrive?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific committed time window and proactively update the customer if it changes, rather than waiting to be asked.

top_questions.question: Can you offer credit period / payment terms?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain that credit terms are evaluated case-by-case for established accounts and escalate promptly to the manager for a decision.

top_questions.question: Can you cut material to custom sizes?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm cutting/processing capability and give a realistic turnaround time instead of a vague 'check and call back'.

top_questions.question: Why did the price change from the last quote?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain that rates are market-linked and always state a validity date on every quote to avoid repeat disputes.
